name: list_projects
title: List the user's Meerkat projects
description: Read-only. Lists the project folders the user has in their Meerkat workspace, most-recently-updated first. Use this when the user wants to file something into a specific project — call list_projects to confirm the project exists, then pass its id to save_specimen or chat_with_meerkat.

query.description: Optional. Case-insensitive substring filter on the project name. Omit to list all projects.

limit.description: Optional. Max projects to return. Defaults to 20.
